speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng
text: asked the Minister for Social and Family Development (a) whether he can provide an update on problem gambling in Singapore; (b) what is his assessment on the effectiveness of the social safeguards introduced since the entry of the Integrated Resorts in 2005; and (c) what new safeguards will be considered going forward.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: This means that they are barred from entering the casinos, fruit machine rooms in private clubs and from betting online with Singapore Pools.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: NCPG also has powers under the Casino Control Act to limit the number of visits an individual can make to the casino each month.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: Under the Third Party Visit Limit regime, NCPG can do so when it notices individuals visiting the casino frequently and gambling beyond their means.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: In addition, if the individual has incurred debt due to gambling, NCPG may even bar the person from entering the casino by issuing a Third Party Exclusion Order, that is, the person cannot enter the casino at all.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: Many locals have also chosen under the Self-Exclusion Scheme to voluntarily exclude themselves from the casinos or fruit machine rooms in private clubs, or from opening an online account with Singapore Pools.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: The objective of the existing social safeguards is to try to minimise the negative impact of gambling by targeting the problem gamblers and the financially vulnerable.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: Having said that, every family that suffers harm because of problem gambling is one case too many.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: Therefore, we will continue our efforts to address problem gambling by putting in place even more upstream and preventive measures.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: For online gambling offered by Singapore Pools, we have already taken steps by requiring punters to set limits on their expenditure, and we will review how to improve this.
